## Activity

During May 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 399 captures. Activity was reviewed as part of the routine site operations report. The recorded total provides the basis for monitoring image submission and subsequent grading activity during the month. No additional activity figures are reported for this period.

## Image quality

Image quality results identified 13 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. The ungradable findings are reported alongside total capture activity to support routine review of image quality at Market Eye Clinic. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 104 referable results from the captures submitted during May 2022. The median lag from capture to grading was 23 days. These results provide the main operational measures for the reporting period and should be considered together with the image quality findings. No further grading performance measures are included in this report.
